changes.title: API version 2026-10 is the latest stable version, supported until at least October 2027

source.quote: 2026-10 is the latest stable API version. It's available for production use until at least October 1, 2027 at 15:00 UTC:

changes.title: priceRule removed from DraftOrderDiscountNotAppliedWarning and PriceRule types removed in 2026-10

source.quote: The deprecated `priceRule` field is removed from `DraftOrderDiscountNotAppliedWarning`. The legacy `PriceRule` object and related types are also removed from the public schema.

changes.title: ITEM_NOT_STOCKED_AT_LOCATION error removed from inventory quantity mutations in 2026-10

source.quote: The obsolete `ITEM_NOT_STOCKED_AT_LOCATION` error is removed from `InventoryAdjustQuantities`, `InventoryMoveQuantities`, and `InventorySetOnHandQuantities`, and from the `InventorySetQuantitiesUserErrorCode` enum.

changes.title: Customer Account API removes Customer.lastIncompleteCheckout and the Checkout type in 2026-10

source.quote: The deprecated `Customer.lastIncompleteCheckout` field is removed, along with the unreachable `Checkout` type subtree.

changes.title: @shopify/shopify-api 15.0.0 removes eventId and resourceId from events webhook deliveries

source.quote: Shopify is dropping the `shopify-event-id` and `shopify-resource-id` headers from events deliveries, so the libraries no longer read them. Both fields are gone from the public types, which makes this a breaking change.

changes.title: @shopify/shopify-api 14.0.0 requires Node.js 22 and removes webhook subTopic

source.quote: Require Node.js 22 or later. Node.js 20 is no longer supported. Upgrade your runtime to Node.js 22 or newer before updating.
